title: Agents Can Do More; Who Keeps Control?
description: DeepSeek updates its model and search tools, while Anthropic examines changing work; website access, default models, and human takeover shape real agent workflows.

coverage_gaps.Google AI Blog: The configured20-entry feed was last dated October13 and yielded no window entries. Upstream checks of two category pages found four additional window articles by reading publication metadata; bodies were not read. Local incremental review found the RSS older than October16 entries already discovered upstream. The RSS cannot establish no final-hour updates. This core source remains partially covered.
coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirected to Source AI; static and rendered cards lacked dates and the configured feed returned HTTP410. Alternative ten-entry AI-topic and Source feeds yielded three candidates, but do not establish coverage of the configured entry point. Local incremental review did not fully obtain the dynamic cards’ dates and window coverage.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remains dated in2025 and cannot establish no updates. Only the first screen of the new research site was rendered upstream, without pagination; stale page-config data and empty retrieval were inconclusive. Supplementary HF creation times are not announcement dates and GitHub pushes are not release checks. Local incremental review did not fully verify the new dynamic list. Configuration was not changed.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The configured homepage was a platform/navigation page without dated news cards. Linked news cards were dated in August; page-modification metadata is not news publication time. Upstream rendered changelog entries extended only to September21. Local incremental review received a script shell; old dates do not establish current updates or complete coverage.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: Upstream read the October17 API change-log sections on search access and the Flash update, retained two day-precision candidates, and separately checked older official news/harness pages. GitHub organization checks retained four harness prereleases from repositories pushed in the window; commits and rendering timestamps were not treated as announcements. Local incremental scripts did not handle this source and browser follow-up remained necessary for final-hour completeness. The selected original update was read, but this does not complete whole-source incremental coverage.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: Configured news/research paths showed older September/August dates upstream; bodies were not read and model-navigation dates were not treated as publication dates. Local incremental review returned a product homepage with mixed older news, without a complete dated list.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The rendered homepage says Step5Preview weights are available, but has no news stream or absolute publication dates. Upstream retained the same three model/repository/blog candidates as the preceding issue; repository creation, pushes and model modification times do not establish when weights became public. Other commits were not announcements and were not read individually. Local incremental review could not obtain a verifiable dated list, so upstream candidates are retained.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: Upstream article-card publication epochs yielded two window candidates, with no October17 card. The data-date attribute was two hours ahead of publication epochs and was not used; unrelated event dates were not treated as news. Bodies were not read. Local incremental review encountered mixed event/news dates and did not fully establish final-hour coverage.
coverage_gaps.OECD.AI: Upstream deduplicated16 Wonk articles using embedded date_gmt fields, latest October12, with no window entries; other page date-like values were not publication dates. Bodies were not read. Local incremental review could read the latest-articles area, but relative dates and timestamp precision did not establish the final-hour boundary.
coverage_gaps.Hugging Face Daily Papers: Upstream retained269 deduplicated recommendations,30 also present in the current arXiv window list. Recommendation dates were kept separate from submission dates; full texts were not read in list collection. The October17 API was empty and October18 returned400 as not yet generated. These responses do not establish no new papers or no continuing changes to the preceding working day’s list. All269 upstream entries are retained.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The homepage and venue directory were available, but neither announcements nor venue lists establish window submissions. Newly submitted papers were not searched venue by venue. Local incremental review therefore retained the discovery-coverage gap.
coverage_gaps.GitHub Trending（日榜 + Python 日榜）: Upstream daily and Python snapshots yielded21 deduplicated repositories with API metadata; sponsor links were removed and non-AI repositories retained for editorial review. This is a ranking snapshot, not a list of projects newly released in the news window. The live list was readable locally, but a snapshot exactly at06:00 could not be reconstructed. Saved discoveries are retained; stars and current ranking positions are not publication dates. This core source remains partially covered.
coverage_gaps.36氪 AI 频道（逐篇核验原创与转载）: Upstream pagination retained150 records,149 in the window, inspecting article metadata, bylines and opening/closing attribution. Bodies were not read in full. Source types distinguished contributor, original, unclassified and syndicated entries. Local incremental review returned an incomplete dynamic list without precise times, preventing complete final-hour verification.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Earlier rendered cards were dated October13 or earlier and preceded the window; the October13 card’s original publication timestamp had previously been checked. Bodies were not read. Local incremental review returned navigation only, without dated cards or pagination, so current news coverage was not complete.
coverage_gaps.TechCrunch: Upstream checked three AI-category pages, retaining20 window records and excluding ticket/event items; list collection did not read bodies. Local incremental review could read the day’s list, but some relative times were beyond cutoff and complete precise publication boundaries remained unverified. Separately verified article text and upstream records are retained.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: Upstream first-page timestamps yielded seven window entries and extended before the window start. Bodies were not read and original/syndicated status was not determined. Local access returned403, leaving final-hour list coverage unverified.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Upstream rendered-topic and ten-entry-feed checks retained one window entry, with no additional window-day links from the rendered list. Bodies were not read. Local incremental review returned blocking text and did not verify the final-hour list.
coverage_gaps.404 Media: Upstream homepage and two following pages yielded13 window-day entries, extending before the window start. Bodies were not read and non-AI titles were retained for editorial review. The day’s page was readable locally, but cards had only day-level dates, leaving final-hour additions and discovery boundaries incomplete.
